# MyCoffeeLab

MyCoffeeLab publishes coffee calculators and eleven house-default drink recipes. Numbers are grams. The production host is not chosen yet.

## Calculators

- [Coffee to water ratio](/calculators/coffee-to-water-ratio/): default is the SCA golden cup, 55 g per litre (about 1:18.2). 1:16 is a shop preset, not the SCA standard. Bloom water is part of the total.
- [Espresso ratio](/calculators/espresso-ratio/): yield = dose × ratio. 18 g at 1:2 is 36 g. Shot time is a note, not a calculated law.
- [Cold brew ratio](/calculators/cold-brew-ratio/): finished liquid subtracts water held by the grounds. Default retention is an assumption of 2 g water per 1 g coffee.
- [Caffeine half-life calculator](/calculators/caffeine-half-life-calculator/): pharmacokinetic clearance decay model and sleep cutoff predictor based on biological half-life.
- [Espresso dial-in calculator](/calculators/espresso-dial-in-calculator/): flow rate diagnostic tool for under-extracted sour or over-extracted bitter shots.
- [Coffee grind size chart](/calculators/coffee-grind-size-chart/): universal particle micron converter for Fellow Ode, Baratza Encore, and Comandante.
- [Iced coffee ratio calculator](/calculators/iced-coffee-calculator/): Japanese flash brew calculator partitioning 60% hot water and 40% ice.

## Drinks

House defaults live under /drinks/. A Gibraltar cortado is not a Spanish cortado. A caramel-syrup macchiato is not the espresso macchiato page. Doppio is a section of /drinks/espresso/, not its own URL.

## Comparisons

Five pairs under /compare/. Rendered inside calibrated architectural vitrines with a grounded baseline plinth and central metric ruler. The reverse slug redirects to the canonical pair.

## Interactive Tools

Interactive 3D Coffee Studio and Drink Matchmaker available on the homepage. No user accounts required; all math runs client-side.
